external_entities.name: customer company
external_entities.description: A customer organization using the invoicing service as a tenant.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Each customer company is one tenant

external_entities.name: customer user
external_entities.description: A person at a customer company who uses the billing app as an admin or viewer.
external_entities.source_excerpt: People at a customer company use the billing app in their browser over HTTPS.
external_entities.notes: Each user belongs to one company and is either an admin or a viewer.

external_entities.name: payer
external_entities.description: The person who receives an invoice email and views the payment page.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Each invoice email sends the payer a link that ends in the invoice number.

external_entities.name: support agent
external_entities.description: A support employee who uses the admin console and can open billing-app sessions as customer users.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Our support agents work from the support office network.

processes.name: billing app
processes.description: The shared application used for invoicing, authentication, invoice access and PDF requests.
processes.source_excerpt: all companies share one billing app
processes.notes: The app's invoice-company check and request-time role check are not documented.

processes.name: PDF renderer
processes.description: A worker that reads invoices and writes rendered PDFs.
processes.source_excerpt: The PDF renderer takes jobs off the queue one at a time

processes.name: admin console
processes.description: A console from which support agents can open sessions in the billing app as customer users.
processes.source_excerpt: From the admin console an agent can open a session in the billing app as any customer user.

data_stores.name: tenant database
data_stores.description: A shared PostgreSQL database containing every company's invoices, customers and payout bank details.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The billing app keeps every company's invoices, customers and payout bank details in one PostgreSQL database, the tenant database.
data_stores.notes: Every table has a company ID column; the database has no row-level security; the app uses one database account for all companies.

data_stores.name: render queue
data_stores.description: A queue carrying PDF render jobs with a company ID and invoice number.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The billing app puts a render job on the render queue.

data_stores.name: PDF bucket
data_stores.description: A shared bucket holding generated PDFs under company IDs and invoice numbers.
data_stores.source_excerpt: one PDF bucket in our cloud platform
data_stores.notes: The billing app fetches PDFs with one service credential for all companies.

data_flows.name: use billing app
data_flows.description: A customer user accesses the billing app, including signing in, opening invoices and submitting invoice edits.
data_flows.source_excerpt: People at a customer company use the billing app in their browser over HTTPS.
data_flows.notes: Users authenticate with an email address, password and session cookie; there is no second factor.
data_flows.authentication: email address and password; session cookie
data_flows.data_description: Authentication requests, invoice and customer data, payout bank details, and invoice edits

data_flows.name: view payment page
data_flows.description: A payer follows an invoice-number link and views the invoice, company name and bank details.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The payment page shows the invoice, the company's name and its bank details, and it asks the payer to sign in to nothing.
data_flows.data_description: Invoice, company name and bank details

data_flows.name: send invoice email
data_flows.description: The billing app sends an invoice email containing a link ending in the invoice number to the payer.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Each invoice email sends the payer a link that ends in the invoice number.
data_flows.data_description: Invoice email and invoice-number link

data_flows.name: query invoices
data_flows.description: The billing app reads and saves invoice, customer and payout bank-detail records in the tenant database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The billing app adds the company filter to each query itself
data_flows.notes: The app connects with one database account for all companies.
data_flows.authentication: one database account for all companies
data_flows.data_description: Invoices, customers and payout bank details

data_flows.name: enqueue render job
data_flows.description: The billing app puts a render job carrying a company ID and invoice number on the render queue.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The job carries a company ID and an invoice number.
data_flows.data_description: Company ID and invoice number

data_flows.name: take render job
data_flows.description: The PDF renderer takes render jobs from the queue.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The PDF renderer takes jobs off the queue one at a time
data_flows.data_description: Render jobs containing a company ID and invoice number

data_flows.name: read invoice
data_flows.description: The PDF renderer reads the invoice from the tenant database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: reads the invoice from the tenant database
data_flows.notes: The renderer trusts the company ID carried by the job.
data_flows.data_description: Invoice data

data_flows.name: write PDF
data_flows.description: The PDF renderer writes a generated PDF to the PDF bucket under a company ID and invoice number.
data_flows.source_excerpt: writes the PDF to the PDF bucket under the company ID and the invoice number
data_flows.data_description: Rendered invoice PDF, company ID and invoice number

data_flows.name: fetch PDFs
data_flows.description: The billing app fetches generated PDFs from the PDF bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The billing app fetches PDFs from the bucket with one service credential for all companies.
data_flows.notes: One service credential is used for all companies.
data_flows.authentication: one service credential for all companies
data_flows.data_description: Generated invoice PDFs

data_flows.name: sign in admin console
data_flows.description: A support agent signs in to the admin console using an account and one-time code.
data_flows.source_excerpt: each agent signs in to it with their own account and a one-time code
data_flows.data_description: Admin-console credentials

data_flows.name: open user session
data_flows.description: The admin console opens a billing-app session as any customer user for a support agent.
data_flows.source_excerpt: From the admin console an agent can open a session in the billing app as any customer user.
data_flows.notes: Everything the agent then does is recorded against the customer user, not the agent.
data_flows.data_description: Customer-user session and subsequent customer-user actions

trust_boundaries.name: customer company
trust_boundaries.description: The customer-company tenant or party boundary for people belonging to a customer company.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Each customer company is one tenant
trust_boundaries.notes: The text describes multiple customer companies; shared application and storage components are not placed in this boundary.

trust_boundaries.name: cloud platform
trust_boundaries.description: The cloud-platform location named for the shared billing app, tenant database and PDF bucket.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: one billing app, one database and one PDF bucket in our cloud platform

trust_boundaries.name: support office network
trust_boundaries.description: The network from which support agents can reach the admin console.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Our support agents work from the support office network.
trust_boundaries.notes: The admin console is reachable only from there.

assumptions.assumption: The customer company is a separate party controlling the tenant boundary.
assumptions.basis: The text says each customer company is one tenant.

assumptions.assumption: The shared billing app runs in the named cloud platform.
assumptions.basis: The text says all companies share one billing app in our cloud platform.

assumptions.assumption: The tenant database runs in the named cloud platform.
assumptions.basis: The text says all companies share one database in our cloud platform.

assumptions.assumption: The PDF bucket runs in the named cloud platform.
assumptions.basis: The text says all companies share one PDF bucket in our cloud platform.

assumptions.basis: People use the billing app in their browser.

assumptions.basis: It contains invoices, customer records and payout bank details.

assumptions.basis: Its jobs carry company IDs and invoice numbers used to render invoices.
